description: Nudge a worker by text about a task list (POST /lists/:id/nudge), through the same guards as the Simple page's nudge: the list must be yours, the recipient must be known to your org, burst limits, the SMS quota and STOP opt-outs apply, and the list link is appended. Send worker_id or phone (one), and an optional message (at most 300 characters). tascan_send_sms is the general text lane. Full tier.
name: tascan_nudge_worker
